sentences.englishText: Land cleared of trees is exposed to erosion, which can be severe in deforested areas having slopes greater than 15 and 17 percent.
sentences.turkishText: Yüzde 15 ve 17 oranından daha fazla oranda yüksek yamaçlara sahip ormansız alanlarda, ağaçtan arındırılmış topraklarda erozyon şiddetli olabilmektedir.

sentences.englishText: If land is not disturbed any further and new growth becomes established, erosion may gradually subside.
sentences.turkishText: Eğer toprak herhangi bir ileri ve yeni ürünle rahatsız edilmezse, erozyon belki yavaş yavaş yatışabilir.

enrichment.summary: Land cleared of trees is exposed to erosion, which can be severe in deforested areas having slopes greater than 15 and 17 percent. If land is not disturbed any further and new growth becomes established, erosion may gradually subside.

questions.question:
Metindeki 1. cümleyi doğru kelimeyle tamamlayın:
Land cleared of trees is exposed to erosion, which can be severe in ____ areas having slopes greater than 15 and 17 percent.

Metindeki 2. cümleyi doğru kelimeyle tamamlayın:
If land is not disturbed any further and new growth becomes ____, erosion may gradually subside.
